data.item: Medicine co-payment for Civil Health Insurance subscribers and beneficiaries: 5% of the price of each medicine item on prescriptions from MoH hospitals, specialist clinics and health centres
data.item_ar: يستوفى من المشترك وأي من المنتفعين معه والمتبرع بالدم مبلغ بنسبة (5%) عن كل صنف دواء يوصف للمريض
data.notes: min = 250 fils per medicine item; max = 10 JD for the whole prescription. Art. 3(a). Instructions No. 1/2007 (amending 7/2005 and 2/2004) under art. 15(b) of Civil Health Insurance Regulation No. 83/2004, Gazette 4808 of 2007-02-15, as compiled in the MoH Health Insurance Administration guide 'دليل نظام التأمين الصحي المدني وتعليماته - 2016' (guide pp. 55-56). A 2025 amendment (Gazette, March 2025) changed art. 5 on chronic-disease prescriptions; amounts below were not reported as changed, but the 2025 text was not read.

data.item: Fee per medicine item for 'non-able' (غير المقتدر), disabled and their beneficiaries
data.item_ar: يستوفى من غير المقتدر والمعاق وأي من المنتفعين معهم مبلغ (250) فلساً عن كل صنف من أصناف الدواء
data.notes: Per medicine item on discharge or specialist/health-centre prescriptions. Art. 4(a). Instructions No. 1/2007 (amending 7/2005 and 2/2004) under art. 15(b) of Civil Health Insurance Regulation No. 83/2004, Gazette 4808 of 2007-02-15, as compiled in the MoH Health Insurance Administration guide 'دليل نظام التأمين الصحي المدني وتعليماته - 2016' (guide pp. 55-56). A 2025 amendment (Gazette, March 2025) changed art. 5 on chronic-disease prescriptions; amounts below were not reported as changed, but the 2025 text was not read.

data.item: Fee per medicine item for children covered under art. 27 of the regulation (children under six)
data.item_ar: يستوفى من الطفل المشترك بموجب أحكام المادة (27) من النظام مبلغ (250) فلساً عن كل صنف
data.notes: Art. 4(b). Guide index describes art. 27 as treatment of children under six. Instructions No. 1/2007 (amending 7/2005 and 2/2004) under art. 15(b) of Civil Health Insurance Regulation No. 83/2004, Gazette 4808 of 2007-02-15, as compiled in the MoH Health Insurance Administration guide 'دليل نظام التأمين الصحي المدني وتعليماته - 2016' (guide pp. 55-56). A 2025 amendment (Gazette, March 2025) changed art. 5 on chronic-disease prescriptions; amounts below were not reported as changed, but the 2025 text was not read.

data.item: Fee per referral from a general practitioner to a specialist (comprehensive-centre specialist clinics or hospitals)
data.item_ar: يستوفى مبلغ (250) فلساً من كل من المشترك وغير المقتدر والمعاق ... عن كل تحويل يصدر عن طبيب عام إلى طبيب اختصاصي
data.notes: Referral valid 14 days. Art. 5(a). Instructions No. 1/2007 (amending 7/2005 and 2/2004) under art. 15(b) of Civil Health Insurance Regulation No. 83/2004, Gazette 4808 of 2007-02-15, as compiled in the MoH Health Insurance Administration guide 'دليل نظام التأمين الصحي المدني وتعليماته - 2016' (guide pp. 55-56). A 2025 amendment (Gazette, March 2025) changed art. 5 on chronic-disease prescriptions; amounts below were not reported as changed, but the 2025 text was not read.

data.item: Civil Health Insurance: emergency visit to a contracted private hospital covered up to this amount without prior approval
data.item_ar: مراجعة طوارىء المستشفيات الخاصة المتعاقد معها لغاية مبلغ (75) دينار مباشرة
data.applies_to: Civil Health Insurance contracted private hospitals
data.notes: Above 75 JD needs approval from the contracted company. Insurance fund covers 80% of private-hospital treatment cost; the patient pays 20%. Medicines: patient pays 5% per item, min 250 fils, max 10 JD per discharge prescription. Applies to first-class and second/third-class government-employee categories (MoH HIA brochure, undated; downloaded 2026-10-24).

data.item: COVID-19 inpatient tariff, private hospital: First class, regular isolation room
data.item_ar: الدرجة الأولى في غرفة العزل العادية
data.notes: MoH unified COVID-19 inpatient tariff for private hospitals, for Jordanians without Civil Health Insurance (Al-Mamlaka 2020-12-09). Includes stay, hotel services, medical supervision, nursing, diagnostics, CT, psychiatric consultation, immunity drugs and supplies. The article does not state whether the amount is per day or per stay ('ستحتسب تكلفة علاج المريض بحسب التسعيرة طيلة الإقامة'). ICU had no fixed price. Historical (2020).
